purpose: Pilot private-input predicate: 16 committed reserve slots, tagged by the eight GENIUS Act 4(a)(1)(A) categories, must cover the committed payment stablecoins outstanding. OCG section 25: inputs are sha256-salted@1 commitments, the receipt holds only the yes/no verdict. Integer only, no haircut, witness is 16 slots of 20 digits. Not proof reserves exist, are unencumbered, approved, or free of 4(a)(2) rehypothecation, nor the Act monthly report. Proof deferred; result is a preview, not a receipt.
